import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
import lightgbm as lgb
import math
import gc


# Haversine distance function
def haversine(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    R = 6371  # Earth's radius in kilometers
    lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2 = map(np.radians, [lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2])
    dlat = lat2 - lat1
    dlon = lon2 - lon1
    a = np.sin(dlat / 2) ** 2 + np.cos(lat1) * np.cos(lat2) * np.sin(dlon / 2) ** 2
    c = 2 * np.arcsin(np.sqrt(a))
    return R * c


# Manhattan distance function for NYC grid pattern
def manhattan(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    return np.abs(lat2 - lat1) + np.abs(lon2 - lon1)


# Load data - use even larger subset for better performance
train_labels = pd.read_csv("./input/labels.csv", nrows=3000000)
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Clean train data: strict filtering for NYC coordinates
train = train_labels.copy()
train = train[train["fare_amount"] > 0]
train = train[train["fare_amount"] < 1000]
train = train[train["passenger_count"].between(0, 6)]

# Filter for NYC area coordinates only (remove corrupted values)
train = train[
    (train["pickup_latitude"] > 40.5)
    & (train["pickup_latitude"] < 41.8)
    & (train["pickup_longitude"] > -74.3)
    & (train["pickup_longitude"] < -73.5)
]
train = train[
    (train["dropoff_latitude"] > 40.5)
    & (train["dropoff_latitude"] < 41.8)
    & (train["dropoff_longitude"] > -74.3)
    & (train["dropoff_longitude"] < -73.5)
]

# Extract datetime components
train["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(train["pickup_datetime"], utc=True)
train["hour"] = train["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
train["day_of_week"] = train["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
train["day_of_month"] = train["pickup_datetime"].dt.day
train["month"] = train["pickup_datetime"].dt.month
train["year"] = train["pickup_datetime"].dt.year

# Add distance features
train["distance"] = haversine(
    train["pickup_latitude"],
    train["pickup_longitude"],
    train["dropoff_latitude"],
    train["dropoff_longitude"],
)
train["manhattan_distance"] = manhattan(
    train["pickup_latitude"],
    train["pickup_longitude"],
    train["dropoff_latitude"],
    train["dropoff_longitude"],
)

# Process test data
test_df["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(test_df["pickup_datetime"], utc=True)
test_df["hour"] = test_df["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
test_df["day_of_week"] = test_df["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
test_df["day_of_month"] = test_df["pickup_datetime"].dt.day
test_df["month"] = test_df["pickup_datetime"].dt.month
test_df["year"] = test_df["pickup_datetime"].dt.year
test_df["distance"] = haversine(
    test_df["pickup_latitude"],
    test_df["pickup_longitude"],
    test_df["dropoff_latitude"],
    test_df["dropoff_longitude"],
)
test_df["manhattan_distance"] = manhattan(
    test_df["pickup_latitude"],
    test_df["pickup_longitude"],
    test_df["dropoff_latitude"],
    test_df["dropoff_longitude"],
)

# Prepare features with Manhattan distance added
feature_cols = [
    "pickup_latitude",
    "pickup_longitude",
    "dropoff_latitude",
    "dropoff_longitude",
    "passenger_count",
    "hour",
    "day_of_week",
    "day_of_month",
    "month",
    "year",
    "distance",
    "manhattan_distance",
]

X = train[feature_cols]
y = train["fare_amount"]

# Split for validation (5% holdout)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.05, random_state=42)

# LightGBM parameters - same as previous best
params = {
    "objective": "regression",
    "metric": "rmse",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "learning_rate": 0.03,
    "feature_fraction": 0.9,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
}

# Train model with early stopping
lgb_train = lgb.Dataset(X_train, y_train)
lgb_val = lgb.Dataset(X_val, y_val, reference=lgb_train)

model = lgb.train(
    params,
    lgb_train,
    num_boost_round=150,
    valid_sets=[lgb_train, lgb_val],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=20), lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],
)

# Validation score
val_preds = model.predict(X_val)
rmse = math.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_val, val_preds))
print(f"Validation RMSE: {rmse:.4f}")

# Predict on test set
test_preds = model.predict(test_df[feature_cols])

# Create submission - use sample_sub template for key order
submission = sample_sub.copy()
submission["fare_amount"] = test_preds
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved.")
